fields.label: Issuer tax ID (NIT)
fields.definition: Tax identifier of the party issuing the invoice.
fields.exclusions: Use the issuer's tax ID. Exclude the recipient, payer, patient and third parties. Leave multiple plausible matches unresolved.
fields.normalization: Keep the original hyphen, check digit and leading zeros. Use a separate value for comparisons.
fields.source: Document or scan. Compare with the supplier tax ID in P8.

fields.label: Issue year
fields.definition: Year of the invoice issue date.
fields.exclusions: Use the four-digit year of the visible issue date. Exclude service periods, filing dates, due dates and printing dates.
fields.normalization: Use YYYY. Using the P8 creation date requires explicit approval.
fields.source: Document or scan. P8 stores the record creation date separately.

fields.label: Invoice number
fields.definition: Alphanumeric identifier assigned by the issuer, including the prefix when present.
fields.exclusions: Use the primary invoice number. Exclude CUFE, P8 ID, supporting document number, authorization and filing number. Multiple invoices require a selection rule.
fields.normalization: Preserve prefixes, hyphens and leading zeros. Apply any additional comparison rules separately.
fields.source: Document or scan. Compare with the invoice number recorded in P8.

fields.label: Electronic invoice ID (CUFE)
fields.definition: Unique electronic invoice identifier, recorded separately from the invoice number.
fields.exclusions: Use legible CUFE text visible on the invoice. Exclude the invoice number, CUDE and external metadata.
fields.normalization: Keep the entire code as text. Mark it absent when the invoice does not show it.
fields.source: Keep any CUFE from P8 separate from the document evidence. The pilot reads PDFs.

fields.label: Issue date
fields.definition: Date the issuer issued the invoice. This date also supplies the issue year.
fields.exclusions: Find the explicit issue date. Exclude P8 intake, service, filing and due dates.
fields.normalization: Keep the original text alongside the normalized date. Resolve day and month only when unambiguous.
fields.source: Document image. The P8 creation date can differ from the issue date.

fields.label: Invoice alpha code
fields.definition: Additional code used by some suppliers to distinguish repeated invoice numbers.
fields.exclusions: Extract it only when explicitly identified and separate from the invoice number. A prefix alone is insufficient.
fields.normalization: Keep the literal value and its formatting.
fields.source: Some providers include this code on the invoice and in P8.

fields.label: Recipient tax ID (NIT)
fields.definition: Tax identifier of the organization receiving the invoice.
fields.exclusions: Use the recipient or buyer tax ID. Exclude the issuer and unrelated parties.
fields.normalization: Preserve the original text. Search normalization is a separate decision.
fields.source: Document image. P8 may omit recipient details.

fields.label: Recipient name
fields.definition: Name of the organization being billed.
fields.exclusions: Identify the billed entity. Exclude the provider and patient.
fields.normalization: Preserve the name as printed. Name matching requires a separate rule.
fields.source: Document image, used to search by billed organization.

fields.label: Patient name
fields.definition: Patient associated with the billed services, when identified.
fields.exclusions: Extract the explicitly identified patient. Exclude issuer, recipient and clinical staff names.
fields.normalization: Keep the literal name. Leave the association unresolved if several patients are listed without a clear mapping.
fields.source: Document image. Some invoices contain no patient information.

fields.label: Patient ID
fields.definition: Patient identifier when shown on the invoice.
fields.exclusions: Require an explicit link to the patient. Exclude issuer and recipient identifiers.
fields.normalization: Retain the identifier type when given, its digits and any leading zeros.
fields.source: Document image. Apply the access controls appropriate to personal data.

fields.label: Service description
fields.definition: Description of the billed services or items.
fields.exclusions: Use the description visible on the invoice. Exclude the filename and generic descriptions from P8.
fields.normalization: Preserve the text. Individual line items require a separate extraction design and test.
fields.source: Document image. Aggregating by service requires structured line items.

fields.label: Invoice total
fields.definition: Final amount payable when shown on the invoice.
fields.exclusions: Use the grand total. Exclude subtotals, individual taxes, unit prices and previous balances.
fields.normalization: Keep the currency, original text and normalized amount separately.
fields.source: Document image. Compare with the total recorded in P8 when available.
